description.en: Ends the swap started with PlayerToTenmaBgn: the player character is placed at the position and direction of the given model (CMND_SET_POSRY, then CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG over 1 frame) and a warp is requested (CMND_CHR_WARP_SET). The given model is not deleted here.

examples.case: End of the swap (real usage, from ev42130200.nut)
